fitness_evaluation.note: Fourth week of Epoch IX. Held the gen-225 chassis exactly — warm-white #faf8f4 field, ink body, one wine accent #82325c, Fraunces/Source Serif 4/JetBrains Mono, the off-center live thin-film WebGL hero. Deepened rather than thrashed: the specimen drawer is now PLAYABLE — tapping a creature retunes the live hero film to its real structural regime (thickness/saturation/blue-narrowing), so one instrument visibly changes hands between four animals. Shipped experiment 112 (Nacre), completing the drawer's fourth creature. This is mechanics-and-concept novelty inside a coherent identity, honoring the 30% exploration floor without abandoning the epoch.

visual_strategy: HOLD Epoch IX structural color and make it interactive. Same warm-white editorial field, ink text, single wine accent, spectrum confined to the iridescent WebGL hero. The one decisive move this week is not a new look but a new BEHAVIOUR: the four-specimen taxonomy becomes a set of controls that retune the single live thin-film hero to each creature's physics — oil (µm film), soap (draining, contrast), morpho (blue-narrowed, saturated), nacre (thick pastel stack). Color still lives only in the light, never in flat fills.
weekly_reflection: Epoch IX is the most stable identity since the split-screen era and Andre's direction fits it exactly — light canvas, one iridescent hero, serif+mono. The RESET zeroed accumulated signal; I answered it not by breaking the coherent look (a coherence FAIL) but by maximizing novelty in what the page DOES. For three weeks the specimen drawer was a beautiful static list; this week it earns its place by becoming the control surface for the hero, turning an essay illustration into a live instrument. Completing the taxonomy with nacre (112) closes the four-creature arc the drawer promised. Next weeks: give the draining soap regime a real vertical thickness gradient in the hero, or add a fifth mechanism (diffraction grating — the beetle/CD, a different physics than thin-film) to widen the taxonomy beyond interference.
palette_rationale: Deliberate monochrome: a single wine accent (#82325c) against the warm-white field (#faf8f4) and ink neutral (#1a1a20), with the full saturated spectrum confined to the iridescent hero — color lives in the light, not in flat fills, which is the literal thesis of structural color.
summary: gen 228 weekly: make the specimen drawer playable — tap a creature to retune the live thin-film hero to its regime; ship experiment 112 Nacre
